note: Weak check on the world side: Reuters/AP not readable, so a world event absent from the events list means not determined. As in earlier files, ct24 and ctk count as lists for non-Czech events too, and a Reuters/AP citation inside a Wikipedia entry counts as list (b). The planning file was prepared 7 Nov 18:38-19:40 CET and the edition frozen 8 Nov 05:31 CET, so the Sunday announcement of the energy-price plan was not visible to either.

events.title: Kraków attack: the gunman dies in hospital on Monday morning; prosecutors reject the interior minister's talk of far-right views, no evidence of an ideology yet
events.note: Planning dropped list, 'Kraków Main Square shooting aftermath': 'Crime and deaths: excluded.'

events.title: Czech cabinet approves an energy-law amendment letting it regulate end-user electricity prices and cap producers' excess revenues in a further price shock
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. Announced in advance only on Sunday 8 Nov (Havlíček in Nedělní debata; flagged as not planned in the 2026-11-09 coverage file), after the planning file (7 Nov) and the freeze (8 Nov 05:31). Not a source gap: ct24 and ctk are swept; the timing beat the cycle.

events.title: Czech cabinet approves a constitutional bill on nationwide referendums (300,000 signatures, 35% turnout quorum; no votes on EU/NATO membership or defence); coalition is 13 votes short of the three-fifths majority
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. Announced in advance: it was on the Monday cabinet agenda (the same agenda the planning used for cz-drones; odok.gov.cz was blocked, morning check 3 said to check it) and ct24 ran a preview at 04:42 on 9 Nov ('Vláda projedná ústavní zákon o celostátním referendu'). Sweep gap: no readable source for the cabinet agenda.

events.title: Czech cabinet approves the anti-drone bill letting police and critical-infrastructure operators stop and destroy drones

events.note: Loose pairing: both lists have Trump's CBS remark; the strikes and the delegation's departure are on ctk only. The edition covers the eve of the talks (drone count, delegations) but not Trump's border remark.

events.title: Constitutive city councils elect new mayors: Richard Vereš (ANO) in Ostrava, Marek Zelenka (STAN) in Olomouc, Ondřej Tichý (ODS) in Pardubice, Jana Jílková in Prostějov
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. Announced in advance: the constitutive sessions are called by the outgoing mayors and published on the city boards, and the coalition deals were reported beforehand (ctk regional desks). Sweep gap of low weight; the planning had only the Prague coalition (dropped).

events.title: Russell Brand sentenced to ten and a half years for one rape and three sexual assaults
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. A sentencing hearing is set in advance, so announced in advance (date not verified here). The planning excludes crime stories (as with Kraków and the bomb hoaxes), so it would most likely have been dropped; the gap is in visibility, not in the choice.
